name: Dancing Every Night
author: Docteurbob
description:
A community rhythm game in the spirit of osu!. Six lanes on two arcs, taps, holds, double notes and scratches, with 3 official songs.
Install new songs made by other players (copy the .zip into ux0:data/dancingeverynight/import/) or make your own with the free online editor. Song library: https://dancing-every-night.pages.dev/songs/
Open source (GPLv3).
